text: Most U.S. undergraduates vaped in the past 30 days.

room.label: 5C students
room.note: HUMAN: campus set — fill from the 5C survey. Context for the reveal: in the same national survey, 85% of students thought the typical student had vaped in the past 30 days; 14% actually had.

truthSource.label: ACHA-NCHA II, Spring 2019 Undergraduate Reference Group
truthSource.oneLine: VERIFY in PDF: 14.3% of undergraduates used e-cigarettes in the last 30 days (n=54,497).
